scope: desktop keyboard and offline shell plus Android new-journey focus
player_behavior: Desktop keyboard users can jump from the first focusable control to the main content.
All desktop interactive controls retain a visible focus-visible outline and reduced-motion remains honored.
Model probe results and inline field errors announce changes to assistive technology.
Primary model, new-journey, and player-action fields expose meaningful names and input metadata.
Android no longer forces the software keyboard open when the new-journey dialog appears.
offline_boundary: The desktop package no longer imports Google Fonts or another remote font stylesheet.
Chinese serif and monospace typography use platform-local fallback stacks.
Technical runtime details remain collapsed under an advanced diagnostics disclosure.

automated_checks.experience_guard: checks skip link, focus-visible, reduced motion, touch action, no remote font URL, zoom availability, and no Android autofocus

not_proven: macOS packaged WebView keyboard order and visual focus remain unrun without accessibility and capture permissions.
Android TalkBack, text scaling, keyboard, and touch targets remain unrun without a physical adb device.
Windows native focus rendering and high-contrast behavior remain unrun.
